descriptions.dev: Run backend in watch mode (REST + MCP on :3001)
descriptions.test: Run only unit tests (Vitest project: unit)
descriptions.test:integration: Run MCP integration tests (Vitest project: integration; requires backend + Neo4j)
descriptions.test:watch: Run unit tests in watch mode (Vitest project: unit)
descriptions.infra:up: Build and start all containers (neo4j + backend)
descriptions.infra:up:db: Start only Neo4j (for local npm run dev)
descriptions.infra:down:clean: Stop containers and WIPE the database volume
descriptions.mcp:inspect: Open MCP Inspector — connect to http://127.0.0.1:3001/mcp (Streamable HTTP)
